system.description:
KENSAI

Through endless practice, you have learned to unify disparate philosophies of combat into a seamless flow. You no longer see forms as separate, but as facets of the same perfect rhythm. In battle, you move with a style entirely your own, blending techniques that no other warrior can emulate.

Prerequisites BAB +2

You may have two forms active at any one time. You can still only activate one each turn. If both forms offer a bonus to the same thing, you may only benefit from the greater of the two.

Furthermore, you gain the Twin Dragon form:

TWIN DRAGON

Your movements mirror the duality of the dragon, fury and patience, fire and steel. You strike in mirrored balance, every motion feeding the next.

Whilst in this form, you gain the following modifiers:

- The first time you successfully Strike a creature each round, you gain a +1 bonus to DB until the start of your next turn.

- The first time you successfully avoid an attack each round (your DB is not overcome), you gain +1 base damage until the end of your next turn.

Progression Requirements BAB +10

Automated: Combat Form's Use, while you hold one form, asks whether to add the new form beside it or replace it: two forms held as one stance, the second activated through Combat Form as usual, and one form activated each turn. Where both forms give a bonus to the same thing (the same check, the same save, your DB), only the greater applies, worked out roll by roll. A Blended Form fills both places (Graham's B7-7). You also know Twin Dragon, entered through Combat Form like your other forms.
